subject.title: fix(telegram): suppress internal tool warnings in groups

question: Should Telegram groups unconditionally hide marked non-terminal tool-error warnings, or should all channels continue to follow the shared `messages.suppressToolErrors` and upstream status-classification policy?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the documented default for one transport, while current main already provides an opt-in shared policy and the broader issue is tracked at the Codex/OpenClaw warning boundary.

options.title: Keep shared policy
options.body: Remove the unconditional Telegram guard, retain the documented opt-in suppression setting, and fix false-positive warning classification at the shared owner boundary.

options.title: Approve group default
options.body: Explicitly approve Telegram-group-only suppression, document the default divergence, and require live proof for suppressed warnings plus preserved final replies.

options.title: Narrow the safeguard
options.body: Define a shared privacy-sensitive warning category that channels may suppress independently without hiding ordinary tool failures.

recommendation.title: Keep shared policy
recommendation.body: Remove the unconditional Telegram guard, retain the documented opt-in suppression setting, and fix false-positive warning classification at the shared owner boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history places the Telegram dispatch and configuration policy surface primarily in this contributor's work.
